title: LongitudinalObservations
description: Longitudinal stream store living at <patient_dir>/longitudinal_observations.json, beside profile.json. Per bucket-taxonomy.md §3, timeseries (and trended structured) sources do NOT become a pile of dated documents — their parsed observations accumulate here, each carrying a source_ref anchor back to the filed raw export (clinical domain 10_随访与监测). This is the substrate for 单时间点 → 多时间点 → 纵向曲线 → 治疗反应轨迹; profile.json keeps a latest_status snapshot and points consumers here for the trajectory.

obs_type.description: Observation class. vital=vital sign; lab=lab analyte; symptom=clinician/patient-noted symptom; pro=patient-reported outcome; adherence=medication adherence; activity=wearable/activity stream.

value.description: Observed value, numeric or verbatim string.

unit.description: Unit, verbatim. e.g. '%', 'bpm'. Use empty string when unitless.

modality.description: Data nature of the source the observation was parsed from: timeseries (wearable/PRO stream) or structured (trended tabular report).

source_ref.description: Anchor back to the filed raw export sidecar (typically 10_随访与监测/可穿戴导出/<file>.md#L.. or /PRO自报/<file>.md#L..) or a conversation:<ISO8601> reference. Same anchor contract as source_refs[] in the sibling schemas — see schemas/anchor-contract.md §4.
